hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Judging by the geographical specifications, E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 include the Gserskad and Rdoskad Tibetic varieties of northwestern Sichuan under the areally dominant Amdo Tibetan [adx] entry. But sound changes and other developments from proto-Tibetic effectively exclude the two from being Amdo, and arguably form a separate language (**hh:typ:Sun:Khalong**, **hh:vw:Sun:Gser-Rdo**, **hh:typ:Sun:gSerpa**). See also: Amdo Tibetan [adx].
